title: Multiplicativity of translation orbit counts at coprime levels
statement: Let m and n be nonzero natural numbers with gcd(m,n) = 1. For each positive k, let Γ₀(k) be the subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) whose bottom-left entry is divisible by k, and let C(k) be the number of orbits of {Tᶻ : z ∈ ℤ}, where T = ((1,1),(0,1)), acting by left multiplication on SL₂(ℤ)/Γ₀(k). Then C(mn) = C(m)C(n).
lean_statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero n], Nat.Coprime m n → Nat.card (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (Subgroup.zpowers ModularGroup.T) ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 (m * n)))) = Nat.card (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (Subgroup.zpowers ModularGroup.T) ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 m))) * Nat.card (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (Subgroup.zpowers ModularGroup.T) ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 n)))
